Common Questions

FAQ

No. Every quote is free and no obligation. We look at the job, tell you what it needs and what it costs, and there are no hidden costs added once we start.
Yes, we're fully insured. You shouldn't have to worry about anything while we're up on your roof.
All of our work is fully guaranteed. Ask us about the guarantee on your particular job when we quote and we'll put it in writing.
Most roofs can be repaired. Slipped or broken slates, a failed valley or a leak around a chimney are usually fixable on their own. If the battens, felt or most of the covering have reached the end of their life, patching becomes money spent twice, and we'll tell you straight if that's the case.
We fit EPDM rubber, GRP fibreglass and felt flat roofs. Each suits different jobs, from garages and extensions to dormers and terraces, and we'll recommend the right one for your roof and budget.
Yes. We handle everything from a small leak to storm damage. Give us a call and tell us what you're seeing, and we'll arrange to take a look.
We do. We install, repair and clean gutters. Blocked or leaking gutters are one of the most common causes of damp walls and rotten fascias, so they're worth keeping on top of.
We're based in Cheltenham and work across Gloucestershire, including Gloucester, Stroud, Cirencester, Tewkesbury, Bishop's Cleeve, Churchdown, Brockworth and Lydney. If you're nearby and not sure, just ask.
